descriptions.zh: 阿里云百炼轻应用-视频理解-更新配置：通过这个接口可以修改异步任务并发配置。欢迎前往[视频理解控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend)体验。通过SDK方式调用API可参考控制台“API”下的示例。
descriptions.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lightweight application - Video Comprehension - Update Configuration: This API allows you to modify the concurrency configuration for asynchronous jobs. You can try it out in the [Video Comprehension console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend). For examples of invoking this API using the software development kit (SDK), refer to the samples under “API” in the console.
